The '''Southern Ocean''' was a vast body of water on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalimahr/Legends|Kalimahr]]. In the days of the [[Je'daii Order]], the city of [[Rhol Yan]], with a thriving tourist industry, was built on an archipelago stretching out into this ocean.

==Appearances==
